items.title: Count Your Blessings Autumn Wreath
items.alt: Cream “COUNT YOUR BLESSINGS” lettering crosses dark-teal ribbons within a wheat and autumn-leaf wreath.
items.description: A single sunflower brightens the right side of the open oval, with curled gold ribbon edges separating the two lines of text.

items.title: Blessed Floral Teacup on Books
items.alt: A blue-and-white floral teacup marked “BLESSED” rests on two closed books beside a silver spoon.
items.description: Cobalt flowers wrap the gold-rimmed cup above navy and cream cloth covers with blank spines.

items.title: Thankful, Grateful and Blessed Gift Tags
items.alt: Three botanical gift tags reading “THANKFUL,” “GRATEFUL” and “BLESSED” hang from a copper-colored ring.
items.description: Round cream, pointed burgundy and scalloped sage shapes give each word its own paper silhouette and floral decoration.

items.title: God Bless You Gold and Navy Medallion
items.alt: Gold “GOD BLESS YOU” lettering fills a navy circular medallion bordered by olive branches and fine rays.
items.description: The raised serif letters and complete gold rim form a formal round greeting graphic with an evenly balanced central stack.

items.title: Bless This Home Hydrangea Plaque
items.alt: An ivory plaque reading “BLESS THIS HOME” is framed by blue hydrangeas with a small brass key hanging below.
items.description: Gold edging follows the rounded plaque outline, while green leaves and little blue flower buds soften its sides.

items.title: Autumn Blessings Pumpkin Wagon
items.alt: A wooden wagon carries orange pumpkins and red flowers beneath a rust banner reading “AUTUMN BLESSINGS.”
items.description: Metal corner brackets, full spoked wheels and a raised pull handle give the low harvest cart a sturdy silhouette.
